name: promptmd
description: Custom editor for *prompt*.py files: WYSIWYG edit of triple-quoted Markdown strings with f-string placeholder highlighting.

promptmd.promptFilePattern.description: Glob pattern for prompt Python files. Which files open in the Prompt Editor is fixed in the extension; this is for display and future commands.

promptmd.markdownFilePattern.description: Glob pattern for Markdown files. Which files open in the Markdown Editor is fixed in the extension; this is for display and future commands.

promptmd.promptVariablePattern.description: Regex for which top-level variable names to treat as prompt variables (e.g. ".*_PROMPT$").

promptmd.markdownEditorDefault.description: Use Markdown Editor (PromptMD) as default for .md files.

promptmd.promptEditorDefault.description: Use Prompt Editor as default for *prompt*.py files.

promptmd.tokenCounterModel.description: Tokenizer for the format bar token count: cl100k_base (GPT-4/3.5), o200k_base (GPT-4o).

promptmd.editorWidth.description: Editor width: constrained (122ch max) or full.

promptmd.placeholderHighlightStyle.description: How to highlight f-string placeholders: background only, left border only, or both.

promptmd.placeholderValidColor.description: Color accent for valid placeholders; default uses the editor theme.

promptmd.placeholderInvalidColor.description: Color accent for invalid or unknown placeholders; default uses the editor theme.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run compile && npm run build:webview
scripts.dev: concurrently -n ts,webview "npm run watch" "npm run build:webview:watch"
